item.title: German FA backs France’s Diallo for FIFA presidency
item.description: Incumbent Gianni Infantino has resisted repeated calls to resign, citing overwhelming global support.

item.title: Kenya’s milk shortage deepens as drought hits farmers and pushes up prices
item.description: Farmers are receiving higher payments but are producing far less milk and also face rising prices for hay.

item.title: Somalia’s constitutional overhaul tests its fragile federal bargain
item.description: Mohamud’s reforms promise stronger government, but regional resistance and violence threaten the fragile deal of 2012.

item.title: Anthropic raises $81.3bn in biggest IPO of all-time
item.description: AI giant prices shares at $83 in blockbuster market debut.

item.title: Unvaccinated Pennsylvania resident dies amid historic US measles resurgence
item.description: Pennsylvania records eighth measles death of 2026, a day after the US formally loses its 26-year elimination status.

item.title: EU governments approve trade deal with Indonesia to offset Trump tariffs
item.description: The deal, initially concluded in 2025, will see both sides remove import duties on more than 90 percent of products.

item.title: Iran war live: Saudi-led coalition strikes Yemen; ships on fire in Hormuz
item.description: Saudi-led coalition says it destroyed a missile platform in Saada, Yemen, as Iran claims three ships hit mines.

item.title: Israel uses Gaza swimming video to minimise winter hardships
item.description: Israel shared an Al Jazeera video of Palestinians swimming, to suggest winter storms in Gaza can’t be that bad.

item.title: Migrant boat capsizes off Senegal, leaving at least one dead
item.description: Incident comes days after another boat capsized in Senegalese waters, and Spain declared a migration emergency.

item.title: NASA’s Voyager 1 hits record one light-day distance, 50 years after launch
item.description: Voyager 1 reaches one light-day from Earth, marking a historic milestone nearly 50 years after its 1977 launch.

item.title: GTA 6 launches after 13-year wait, breaking pre-order records
item.description: Grand Theft Auto’s latest instalment is out, ending a 13-year wait for one of gaming’s biggest franchises.

item.title: US steps up pressure on Iran-backed Hezbollah with new sanctions
item.description: The US Treasury has accused Hezbollah of using charitable organisations as 'fronts' for fundraising.

item.title: Iraq sentences six French nationals to life in prison for joining ISIL
item.description: Trials began in September for 47 French citizens who were transferred from Syria last year.

item.title: US lawmakers push to raise minimum wage to $25, end tipped pay system
item.description: Public support for raising the minimum wage grows, with 78 percent of voters saying it was an important election issue.

item.title: Floodwaters submerge cars and parking lots in Florida town
item.description: Floodwaters turned streets and parking lots into rivers in Davie, Florida, leaving drivers facing dangerous conditions.

item.title: US Defence Secretary Hegseth reveals military partnership on Venezuela trip
item.description: Pete Hegseth says the agreement will include joint training and intelligence sharing with the Venezuelan military.

item.title: What does Israel’s new ground offensive mean for Palestinians in Gaza?
item.description: Israeli tanks advance beyond the 'Yellow Line', forcing Palestinians to flee again in Gaza.

item.title: Pew Research: Islam on track to become world’s largest religion by 2035
item.description: The report projects steady increases for both Christianity and Islam from 2020 to 2070.

item.title: Putin’s nuclear briefcase makes surprise appearance at China summit
item.description: Russian President Vladimir Putin’s nuclear briefcase was spotted at the APEC summit in China.

item.title: Muslims projected to overtake Christians as world’s largest religious group
item.description: New Pew Research Center projections point to major changes in the world’s religious landscape by 2070.

item.title: US loses measles-free status after 26 years in historic setback
item.description: The US has lost its measles elimination status after 26 years, as its largest outbreak in over three decades continues.

item.title: US lawmakers launch probe into Lutnick’s actions amid Nvidia scandal
item.description: Letter alleges possible conflict of interest in commerce secretary not adding Megaspeed to US trade blacklist.

item.title: Trump and Putin to meet one-on-one in China Thursday
item.description: US and Russia leaders meet in China amid efforts to resolve Ukraine crisis and enhance post-war security guarantees.

item.title: Heated debate escalates into on-air fight on Armenian TV
item.description: A heated political debate on Armenia’s Public Television escalated into a physical altercation

item.title: Four killed as Russian strikes hit Ukraine’s Odesa
item.description: At least four people have been killed and thirteen more injured after Russian strikes hit Ukraine’s port city of Odesa.
